title: Malaysian Quinoa Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious quinoa bowl dish inspired by Malaysian cuisine. Roasted vegetables add a sweet and savory taste.
instructions: Toss sweet potatoes and carrots with 1 tbsp of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
In a small pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add Malaysian chili sauce and stir for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, roasted sweet potatoes, and carrots.
Pour chili sauce mixture over the quinoa mixture and toss to combine.
Garnish with sliced fresh cilantro and serve with lime wedges on the side.
